owner_notes: The block measurements for FTG's towns are built and working on every town saved so far (12 of the 28 planned, plus the two older test cities), and five of the six checks pass. The sixth check says the final measurement must happen after the FTG recording run finishes, and that run was still going (towns 12-27 not yet saved). So this is marked partial, not failed: once the last FTG town is saved, one command re-runs everything with no changes needed.

What we learned: FTG's city blocks are about 2 100-2 400 square metres at the median whatever the town's size; at most about 86-89 % of the land inside its districts can be building plots once roads and walls are taken out, which brackets our own design figure (0.62) comfortably.

Two side findings: FTG puts a wall tower at almost every wall corner but almost never where a street meets the wall on a straight stretch; and each FTG market square is its own block, never next to another market. Neither asks for a change to our design.
